description: This file defines the Breadcrumb class, which models the breadcrumb navigation element within a shopping web application. It contains properties for breadcrumb items, language, URL reference content, and item type.

classes.name: Breadcrumb
classes.description: A Java class that models breadcrumb navigation data, including breadcrumb items, language, URL reference, and item type.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language associated with this breadcrumb.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the language for this breadcrumb.

methods.name: getBreadCrumbs
methods.description: Returns the list of breadcrumb items.

methods.name: setBreadCrumbs
methods.description: Sets the list of breadcrumb items.

methods.name: setItemType
methods.description: Sets the type of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: getItemType
methods.description: Returns the type of the breadcrumb item.

methods.name: getUrlRefContent
methods.description: Returns the URL reference content associated with the breadcrumb.

methods.name: setUrlRefContent
methods.description: Sets the URL reference content for the breadcrumb.
